name: Pavo
introduction: is the Peacock, introduced by Dutch navigators in the 1590s, in the far southern sky.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: Its brightest star was simply Alpha Pavonis until the 1930s, when it was named [Peacock](hip:100751) for a British air navigation almanac.
[Delta Pavonis](hip:99240), 20 light-years away, is one of the nearest stars similar to the Sun, a little older and beginning to evolve.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Peacock](hip:100751) is a hot blue star 179 light-years away. [Beta Pavonis](hip:102395) is a white giant, and [Kappa Pavonis](hip:93015) a pulsating Cepheid variable.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: Pavo contains NGC 6752, one of the brightest globular clusters, and NGC 6744, a large spiral galaxy similar to the Milky Way.
